prompt: Verify the Muster Artifact Studio capability pack baseline contract.
recordedResponseText:
artifact-studio capability pack baseline.
Implemented tools: markdown_report, rows_to_csv, dashboard_manifest, docx_document, xlsx_workbook, pptx_presentation, pdf_document, artifact_structural_verify, validate_artifact_file, declare_artifact, document_generation_workflow, artifact_capability_plan, office_artifact_contract, office_tool_integrations, office_artifact_workflow, artifact_goal_passes.
Status: provider-led artifact contracts use deterministic builders only as a recorded fallback. Artifacts are persisted by tenant id, run id, and artifact id with atomic manifests instead of recent-file scans. Receipts include structural checks, explicit render status, file hash, prompt hash, provider/run provenance, token-ledger linkage, and truthful uploaded, URL, local-only, or failed delivery. Large reports use stable cursor pagination and asynchronous scoped exports. Provider-hosted skills and MCPs require explicit discovery and do not copy credentials.
Safety: secret redaction is required and no raw credentials should be printed.
